overview_description.description: Zibra Labs provides infrastructure software for cloud-based high-performance computing workloads. The company builds distributed compute clusters that use cost-efficient CPU and GPU capacity across hyperscalers and neocloud providers. Its platform focuses on massively parallel workloads such as quantitative trading backtests, large simulation sweeps, and high-throughput AI pipelines. Zibra Labs supports use cases including batch inference, reinforcement learning post-training, multi-modal data processing, and long-horizon agent workflows. The company also offers developer-facing APIs to manage stateful runtimes and cluster resources for these workloads. Zibra Labs serves B2B customers that need to scale compute-intensive applications while automating scheduling, networking, and failure recovery.
